record.label: Pauli exclusion in the short-range interaction
record.statement: In the position basis, a grid point can be occupied by at most one electron of each spin. On these occupations, averaging the two branches of the linear combination of unitaries gives the short-range interaction up to a constant.
record.boundary: The proof splits the number operator by spin. For each spin, applying its count operator twice to a same-spin antisymmetric input gives the same result as applying it once. The two counts commute, and their sum has occupations $0,1,2$ on these inputs. The branch average is $1-n$ for these three values of $n$.
